internal_sources.policy: Use exact OSM feature ID only; take tags from exact record.
Use exact source_id = accepted OSM feature ID only.
Use exact OSM feature ID only; audit fields are supplemental.
Use exact building_osm_id only; photo IDs are references, not verified facade texture.
Consult existing linkage audit; no spatial-only candidate copied.

matching_policy: Only records already linked by accepted containment or exact source-ID methods were enriched. Candidate-only and proximity-review records were not assigned tags. No coordinates, geometry, source IDs or render heights were changed.
photo_policy: Existing facade-photo review entries are indexed in the row but do not count as verified imagery unless the source file marks the facade verified; no automatic image-to-texture assignment.
limitations: The primary 22,977-feature GeoJSON master and 24,102-row master CSV have not yet been fully reconciled against this 1,721-row OpenFreeMap component registry.
The 1,721 records are polygon components, not confirmed distinct physical buildings.
OSM/OFM exact-ID linkage is not equivalent to photo-confirmed architectural identity.
